as_of_content:
The '''Cheetor Relics''' are rewarded for mastering the [[Feral Phenomena]] Spotlight Missions.

== Description ==
''An ancient artifact mutated by quantum energy. Awarded for Mastery of the [[Cheetor]] Special Mission.''

== Relic Boosts ==
* (Tier 1): +1% Attack Rating in Raids when attacking.
* Bronze: +2%
* Silver: +3%
* Gold: +4%
